Title: Villein and a vamp with 1 blood

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
If I have a vampire with only 1 blood, can I play Villein on him,
and take just that 1 blood?

"Put this card on a vampire you control and move 2 or more blood
from that vampire to your pool..."

The reason I ask is I remember LSJ ruling that if Menele had only
1 blood, he could still use his ability with 1 blood, just like
Drain Essence can still be played against a vampire with 1 blood and
steal 1, etc.
